validity_findings.finding: Oracle-free greedy decode implementation (run_experiment.py 222-253 oracle_free_greedy_decode: try brotli then gzip each iteration, prefer br if both succeed, loop until neither succeeds, no SHA check) is functionally equivalent to prereg spec on this data (zero ambiguous tie-breaks). The simultaneous try-both then prefer-br is semantically identical to spec's sequential try-br-then-gz because choice is same (br) when both succeed; method distribution br=60,gz+br=60,gz=80,gz+gz=40 matches parent exactly, and zero ambiguous across 693 observations confirms deterministic paths. No validity threat here.
